# `tfctl harness install`

The `tfctl harness install` command installs coding agent skills for tfctl.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install AGENT [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl harness install` command installs the official tfctl agent skill for the selected platform. The available agent platforms are: `amp`, `antigravity`, `bob`, `claude`, `codex`, `copilot`, `opencode`, or `pi`.

Alternatively, you can use `npx skills` to install the tfctl skill:

```shell-session
$ npx skills add hashicorp/tfctl-cli --skill 'tfctl'
```

## Arguments

- `AGENT` - (Required) The agent to install the skill for. Valid options are: `amp`, `antigravity`, `bob`, `claude`, `codex`, `copilot`, `opencode`, or `pi`.

## Available options

The `tfctl harness install` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `--global` | Install the skill to the agent's global config directory. When not specified, installs to the project directory. | `false` | No |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to install coding agent skills for tfctl.

### Install in the project directory for opencode

The following example installs the tfctl skill for the opencode agent in the current project directory.

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install opencode
```

### Install in the global user directory for codex

The following example installs the tfctl skill for the codex agent in the global user directory.

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install codex --global
```

## Installation Locations

The skill is installed to different locations depending on the agent and the `--global` flag:

### Project Installation (default)

Skills are installed to the agent's project-specific skills directory, typically `.skills/` or similar directory in the current project.

### Global Installation

Skills are installed to the agent's global configuration directory, typically the user's home directory under agent-specific config paths.
